properties.statement:
**ONLY 11 OF REFLOW2'S 20 SERVED SKILLS ARE REGISTERED AS ARTIFACTS, SO NINE CAN BE EDITED WITH NO DRIFT SIGNAL AT ALL.** Found sideways on 2026-08-14 while editing two skills: one produced a `DRIFT` finding and the other produced silence, and the silence was not a pass.

REPRODUCTION (committed export at `c18a4a1`, then re-measured after the edits):
```
skills on disk ....................... 20
registered as Artifacts .............. 11
unwatched ............................  9
```
UNWATCHED: `ci-gate`, `detect-and-ask`, `genesis`, `impact-check`, `link-artifacts`, `report-friction`, `retire-from-design`, `revise-design`, `where-am-i`.

⭐ HOW IT SURFACED, WHICH IS THE POINT. Two served skills were edited the same hour — `ci-gate` (three documented omissions) and `parallel-work` (a contradiction with the lineage rule). `reflow2_check` reported **exactly one** finding: `DRIFT art:parallel-work-skill`. **`ci-gate` changed materially and the gate said nothing**, because no Artifact points at it. Had only `ci-gate` been edited, the gate would have reported OK and the change would have gone in unwatched.

🛑 **THIS IS TODAY'S GENERAL FINDING ARRIVING UNPROMPTED FOR THE FIFTH TIME** (`dec:idea-silence-is-reported-not-inferred`): *reflow2 cannot distinguish "nothing is wrong" from "I could not see it."* Here, **"nothing drifted" and "nothing is watched" are the same answer**, and the answer looks like health. The prior four instances that day: `unrealized_capability` suppressed by `realized_via_component`; the loop-nudge state `absent` meaning two different things; `loop_status` sync reporting `in_step` against an uncommitted graph; and `hierarchy_issues` returning 0 against 14 unparented components.

⚠️ TWO ENTRIES ON THE UNWATCHED LIST ARE POINTED:
  · **`link-artifacts`** — the skill whose entire job is registering artifacts and keeping as-designed honest against as-built — is itself unregistered.
  · **`report-friction`** — the skill for reporting reflow2's own problems — is unregistered, so a change to how friction gets reported leaves no trace.

✅ THE INSTRUMENT THAT WOULD CATCH THIS ALREADY EXISTS AND WAS NEVER POINTED HERE. `coverage_report` is built for exactly this class — its own contract says *"every other detector reasons about nodes ALREADY in the graph, so without this a design covering 30% of a system reports the same 0 open gaps as one covering all of it."* It answers only as wide as the sweep it is handed, and **nobody has ever swept `getting-started/skills/`**. This is not a missing capability; it is a built capability never aimed at the tree it was built for.

📌 WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: whether the 9 are unregistered by oversight or by a deliberate choice nobody wrote down — the 11 that ARE registered have no obvious property in common (they span `adopt`, `brainstorm`, `capture-intent`, `capture-session`, `check-health`, `governance-proposal`, `kpp-proposal`, `parallel-work`, `plan-increments`, `ingest-corpus`, `link-projects`), which weakens the deliberate reading but does not kill it. **Also unchecked: whether the same registration hole exists for `tools/`, `crates/` or `docs/`** — only the skills tree was counted, and the honest generalisation of this finding is that nobody knows the coverage of any of them.
